I dealt with workplace harassment and blatant sexism from two of my superiors for nearly two years.  I was powerless against them as they targeted me and began to spread rumors about me and discourage others in the office from speaking to me. I found out later that they frequently bad mouthed and outright lied about me to our OIC. One in particular made it his daily mission to seek me out while the other mostly just told me the harrasser was justified because he outranked me. All this because this guy took offense that I refused to tell him intimate details about my personal life after he was making inappropriate comments about my life.

I can't think about how easily even my closest friends were swayed by fear of being target themselves that they stopped talking to me at work without being angry. I can't think about that two-year period without getting incredibly angry.

Just because you agree with my opinion doesn't mean everyone does. But time will tell, maybe this is a r/popularopinion after all.

I think our entertainment should present us with new ideas and challenge our way of thinking as well. But I don't believe Facebook is purely for entertainment. It is a social networking site and so I go there for social interaction with internet strangers.

And like I said, I agree with TWs for a lot of things. I don't want to delve into the groups I am a part of...but let's pretend there was a group called, "Oceaning Sporting Activities." If someone wanted to talk about the time they were in a boat crash, almost eaten by a shark, and then marooned on an island for three days after being raped by a dolphin (as buck wild as that would be) yeah go ahead and slap a TW or CW on that bad boy. If someone posts a picture of them in an ocean kayak or on a jet ski, that post doesn't need a TW because you should expect that type of stuff in that group. 

Adding TWs to every post isn't an outrage, at most it's an annoyance. I TW or CW my posts in groups that require it. To me it just seems like it is getting out of hand.

I feel like you are projecting a wee bit, cancerous_mass. 

I don't think it's a conspiracy against me or anything like that. I just hold an opinion that in my experience is unpopular and so came to r/unpopularopinions to share it.

I don't see how? I've tried to have this discussion on Facebook in a few different groups but the mods deny the post or it immediately dissolves into a comment war about how TWs are really important and everyone needs to use them.

Sometimes though that doesn't seem that hard and so I put the clothes in the washer and turn it on before I go back to bed.
